deep_dive.title: grapheme-kit: Grapheme-Level Metrics and Text Processing for Multilingual NLP
deep_dive.abstract: Existing lexical distance, similarity, and evaluation metrics operate on Unicode code points, which can misrepresent errors in writing systems where a single grapheme is represented by multiple Unicode code points. We introduce grapheme-kit, an open-source Python library that extends these metrics to operate on grapheme clusters instead. The library also provides improved grapheme processing for Tamil and Sinhala, including accurate grapheme cluster identification and grapheme composition/decomposition utilities. Through an OCR case study, we demonstrate that grapheme-level metrics provide a more faithful evaluation of complex scripts.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: grapheme-kit is an open-source Python library extending lexical metrics to grapheme clusters for accurate evaluation of complex scripts like Tamil and Sinhala, with a case study in OCR.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 现有词汇距离和相似度度量基于Unicode码点，在处理多码点字素时会误判错误。本文提出grapheme-kit，一个开源Python库，将度量扩展到字素簇级别，并为泰米尔语和僧伽罗语提供精确的字素识别与组合分解工具。通过OCR案例研究证明，字素级度量能更忠实地评估复杂文字系统的性能。该库可直接用于多语言NLP评测，降低因字素分割错误导致的评估偏差。
